name: tuneitverse
description: TuneItVerse - Industry-standard open ECU tuning platform (Tauri + Rust)

scripts.build:win-exe: tauri build && powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-ChildItem 'src-tauri/target/release/bundle/nsis' -Filter 'TuneItVerse*-setup.exe' | Copy-Item -Destination '.' -Force; Write-Host 'Fresh .exe installer copied to main TuneItVerse folder'"
